name: HiDream O1 Image
description: HiDream Labs' O1 image model — single-file ComfyUI repack from Comfy-Org. Ships two workflows: Image Gen (text-to-image) and Image Edit (reference-image-driven editing). Both use the same BF16 base checkpoint (~15 GB) with text encoder and VAE bundled. ~15 GB on the ComfyGen volume.

tested_against.note: Both workflows share the BF16 base checkpoint to save disk.

Image Gen: Pure text-to-image with the full BF16 model. Recommended GPU tier or above for the 15 GB checkpoint.
Image Edit: Reference-image-driven editing. Connect a source image via the LoadImage node.
